instructions_to_main_agent: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scroll and Framer Motion for kinetic typography reveals.
Implement language state management (React context or state) for seamless instant FR/EN/ES switching.
Ensure dark ocean theme with high contrast text (min 4.5:1 ratio for body, 3:1 for headings).
Hook the booking form to the FastAPI backend endpoint POST /api/booking with mock success toast notification via Sonner.
Keep header backdrop blurs smooth (backdrop-blur-xl with border-white/10).
Make sure all grid items are direct children or use proper layout structure.
Do not use transparent background on dropdowns or modals.
